FALSE-FRIEND ALERT   Coût de revient, تكلفة الإنتاج
French 'coût de revient' is full cost, including distribution. It is not the U.S. product cost used for inventory. Arabic texts separate تكلفة المنتج (product cost) from تكلفة الفترة (period cost); keep the same split in U.S. terms.

WORKED EXAMPLE   Everything ties

Raw materials: $130,000 + $3,260,000 − $3,240,000 = $150,000.
Work in process: $180,000 + $7,560,000 − $7,050,000 = $690,000.
Finished goods: $420,000 + $7,050,000 − $6,090,000 = $1,380,000.
Ending work in process = direct materials $300,000 + direct labor $114,000 + applied overhead $276,000.
